questions.question: Use the check-supplier-invoice skill: can Zava Matériaux's invoice FA-2026-0217 be paid as it stands?

answer.text:
No — for **chantier Moreau**, Zava Matériaux’s invoice **FA-2026-0217** should **not be paid as it stands**: the delivery note records only **8 palettes received** for article **ZM-20450**, with **“2 palettes manquantes”**, while the invoice bills **10 palettes**.[1][2]

As of the site meeting minutes of **24/03/2026**, the invoice was explicitly to be checked against the **13/03/2026 delivery note before payment**.[3]

| Line (article code) | Billed | Received or ordered | Difference | Amount at stake HT |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| ZM-20450 | 10 palettes at 79,20 € HT, total 792,00 € HT.[1] | OCR delivery note: printed 10 palettes, but handwritten/annotated receipt says **8 palettes received** and **2 palettes missing**.[2] | 2 palettes overbilled | 2 × 79,20 € = **158,40 € HT**.[1][2] |
| ZM-31020 | 30 sacs at 7,90 € HT, total 237,00 € HT.[1] | 30 sacs on the delivery note.[2] | none found | 0,00 € HT.[1][2] |
| ZM-44108 | 24 barres at 9,45 € HT, total 226,80 € HT.[1] | 24 barres on the delivery note.[2] | none found | 0,00 € HT.[1][2] |
| ZM-27340 | 1 unit at 164,00 € HT, total 164,00 € HT.[1] | 1 unit on the delivery note.[2] | none found | 0,00 € HT.[1][2] |
| Delivery fee | 1 forfait at 65,00 € HT.[1] | The delivery note states a camion-grue delivery.[2] | none found | 0,00 € HT.[1][2] |

The invoice totals are **1 484,80 € HT**, **TVA 20 % = 296,96 €**, and **1 781,76 € TTC**.[1]  
The disputed amount is **158,40 € HT**, plus **31,68 € VAT** at 20 %, for **190,08 € TTC**.[1][2]  
The purchase tracking row for **BC-2026-012** lists **1 484,80 € ordered HT** and **1 484,80 € invoiced HT**, with status “Livré le 13/03/2026, facture FA-2026-0217”, but it does not remove the delivery-note reserve on the two missing palettes.[4][2]  

So payment should be blocked or reduced until Zava Matériaux issues a credit note / corrected invoice for **2 palettes of ZM-20450**, or proves subsequent delivery of the missing palettes.[2][3]

questions.question: Use the prepare-site-meeting skill to prepare site meeting no. 4 of the Moreau chantier on 7 April 2026.

answer.text:
Prepared for **site meeting no. 4 — chantier Moreau — 07/04/2026**, as of the latest cited current site record, **Compte rendu de chantier n°3 of 24/03/2026**, and the current planning/purchasing workbook **PLN-2026-003 indice A dated 17/03/2026**.[1][2]

## 1) Progress by task — late or at-risk first

- **T05 Élévation des murs** was scheduled 16/03/2026–27/03/2026 and was only **20 %** complete in planning indice A, so it is the main incomplete task already past its planned finish before the 07/04 meeting.[1]  
- **T06 Charpente, couverture et fenêtre de toit** was scheduled 30/03/2026–03/04/2026 at **0 %**, so it is past its planned finish before the meeting; the same row includes **avenant n°1** in the lot reference.[1]  
- **T07 Livraison des menuiseries** was scheduled for 30/03/2026 at **0 %**, but the later meeting minutes state VanArsdel postponed delivery of order BC-2026-009 to **20/04/2026** and installation to **21/04–23/04/2026**.[1][2]  
- **T08 Pose des menuiseries** was scheduled 31/03/2026–02/04/2026 at **0 %**, but the later minutes’ VanArsdel date implies this installation sequence has slipped to **21/04–23/04/2026**.[1][2]  
- **T09 Électricité 1er œuvre** is scheduled to start on the meeting date, 07/04/2026, and run to 10/04/2026 at **0 %**; the purchase follow-up also states Adatum’s intervention is from **07/04/2026**.[1][3]  
- **T10 Ouverture du mur existant** is scheduled in planning A for 07/04/2026–09/04/2026 at **0 %**, but the later minutes decide to postpone the existing-wall opening until after joinery installation, **27/04–29/04/2026**.[1][4]  
- **T11 Isolation et plâtrerie** is scheduled 13/04/2026–24/04/2026 at **0 %**, and the minutes decide temporary wooden-panel closing on 07/04/2026 so insulation can start from 13/04/2026.[1][5]  
- **T12 Cuisine : dépose et plomberie** is scheduled 27/04/2026–30/04/2026 in planning A at **0 %**, but the later minutes decide to bring the kitchen works forward to **07/04–10/04/2026** with the clients’ agreement.[1][6]  
- **T13 Électricité 2nd œuvre** is scheduled 04/05/2026–06/05/2026 at **0 %**, **T14 Carrelage et faïence** is scheduled 04/05/2026–07/05/2026 at **0 %**, **T15 Pose des meubles de cuisine** is scheduled 11/05/2026–12/05/2026 at **0 %**, **T16 Finitions et nettoyage** is scheduled 13/05/2026 at **0 %**, and **T17 Réception des travaux** is scheduled 15/05/2026 at **0 %**.[1]  
- The minutes keep the works reception date at **15/05/2026**.[7]  

## 2) Deliveries and purchasing points

- **VanArsdel Menuiseries / BC-2026-009**: purchase tracking planned delivery of external joinery on **30/03/2026**, but the later minutes state VanArsdel’s email of 18/03/2026 postponed delivery to **20/04/2026** and installation to **21/04–23/04/2026**.[3][2]  
- **Zava Matériaux / BC-2026-013** for framing timber, tiles and zincwork had delivery planned for **27/03/2026**, with no later confirmation found in the cited evidence.[3]  
- **Zava Matériaux / BC-2026-016** for the roof window and flashing under avenant n°1 had delivery planned for **27/03/2026**, with no later confirmation found in the cited evidence.[3]  
- **Adatum Électricité / BC-2026-008** is tracked as an electrical subcontracting order with intervention from **07/04/2026**.[3]  

## 3) Decisions from site meeting no. 3 to bring forward

- **D1**: temporary closing of openings with wooden panels on **07/04/2026** is decided to allow insulation from **13/04/2026**.[5]

questions.question: Does Zava Matériaux invoice Lamna Bâtiment at the prices of the 2026 framework contract? Give the gaps by chantier.

answer.text:
No: for the Zava Matériaux invoices evidenced in the wiki, Lamna Bâtiment is not always invoiced at the 2026 framework-contract net prices, with gaps on Chantier Moreau and Chantier résidence Les Nacrines as of the current Moreau invoice dated 16/03/2026. [1][2][3][4][5]

The framework contract says the applicable prices are the 2026 framework-contract net HT prices for every order, regardless of delivery chantier, and any line invoiced above the annexed net tariff gives rise to a credit note for the gap. [1][2]

|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Chantier Moreau | ZM-20450 — blocs béton, invoice FA-2026-0217 | €79.20 | €76.80 | 10 palettes | €24.00 HT over the framework price |
| Chantier résidence Les Nacrines | ZM-52730 — treillis d’armature, invoice FA-2026-0158 | €79.00 | €68.00 | 10 rolls | €110.00 HT over the framework price |

On Chantier Moreau, the invoice matches the framework tariff for ZM-31020, ZM-44108, ZM-27340 and delivery, but ZM-20450 is billed €2.40 HT per palette above the €76.80 framework price, giving a €24.00 HT gap on 10 palettes. [3][4]

arguments.question: For the school of Montferrine, which DPGF is current, and what changed between indice A and indice B?

questions.question: Pour l'école de Montferrine, quelle DPGF est en vigueur, et qu'est-ce qui a changé entre l'indice A et l'indice B ?

answer.text:
Pour le chantier **école de Montferrine**, la DPGF en vigueur est **DEV-2026-031 indice B du 13/03/2026**, car l’indice B « annule et remplace » l’indice A du 13/02/2026, per DPGF indice B du 13/03/2026 [1][2].  

Le montant de l’indice B est **87 440,00 € HT**, avec **17 488,00 € de TVA à 20 %**, soit **104 928,00 € TTC** [3][4][5].  

Par rapport à l’indice A, la commune a demandé une modification de consistance lors de la réunion du 06/03/2026 : ajout de **deux fenêtres de la bibliothèque**, postes 2 et 3 portés de **14 à 16 fenêtres**, prix unitaire du poste 4 ramené de **54,00 € à 51,50 € HT**, et poste 6 ramené de **16 400,00 € à 15 900,00 € HT** [6].  

L’écart global annoncé entre l’indice A et l’indice B est de **+2 240,00 € HT**, soit **+2 688,00 € TTC** [7].  

À titre de comparaison, l’indice A remplacé indiquait **85 200,00 € HT**, **17 040,00 € de TVA**, et **102 240,00 € TTC** [8][9][10].
